Taehee Kim 김태희

PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR

Taehee Kim leads DMSE Lab. The lab's research spans sol–gel synthesis of nanoporous aerogels, electrocatalysis for hydrogen and oxygen evolution, electrified CO₂ capture, and machine-learning-driven alloy design.

Kim received a Ph.D. in Materials Science & Engineering from Yonsei University and a B.Sc. (Hons) in Chemistry from the University of Edinburgh, and was a postdoctoral scholar at Northwestern University in the group of Prof. Edward H. Sargent before starting the lab.
